item.title: MacPass 0.8.13-rc2 (75)
item.description:
Changes

Features

  • add KeePass field reference support

Bug Fixes

  • verify Carthage checkout without git metadata
  • preserve first field reference insertion
  • clarify field reference translations

Verification

This release was built with GitHub Actions and includes SLSA build provenance attestations.

To verify the artifacts:

gh attestation verify MacPass-0.8.13-rc2.dmg --owner orestesgaolin

Build Info

  • Version: 0.8.13-rc2
  • Build: 75
  • Runner: macOS 15 (arm64)
  • Commit: e765bf0
